design: Tall elderly rite keeper with a broad rear cranium, three shallow forehead ridges, heavy natural cheek lobes and long silver scalp tendrils bundled low. Long plum robe with three straight front panels, stepped short mantle, bronze circular chest seal and one loose sleeve. Left arm holds a closed weathered teal ritual tablet, right palm displays a small bronze disc. Ash-grey mottled hide; all four mandibles clearly visible.
